summary: Emperor Edition Gempukku pass (#461): all 17 unwired cards wired (holding-wave-10: nine Market Holdings; personality-wave-65: Hida Yamadera, Doji Dainagon, Jade's Roar, Moshi Madoka, Kunji, Shosuro Hawado exp 2, Daigotsu Negishi, Shinjo Byung, all Experienced); Togashi Korimi was already wired, so no new blockers. New primitives: abilities taken from the dead pile (FromDead/RequiresHonorable, source-if-dead), a keyword-limited first Battle action (Jade's Roar's Terrain-only opportunity), PlayerState.AttachedFromHandThisTurn, Negishi's conditional destruction negation by unit Gold Cost, and a card-in-province target with face-up refill (Hawado). Removed the stale Jade's Roar blocker note. Shared scope: content packaging, wave registration and the inventory builder alongside rules-lane engine changes.
validation: Full L5R.Core.Tests suite: zero failures, including the new gempukku-pass suite (10 scenarios). L5R.AI.Tests 74/74, L5R.Server.Tests 8/8, L5R.Client.Transport.Tests 12/12.
